name: elloria

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @elloria/api run build && pnpm --filter @elloria/web run build
scripts.check: pnpm run spellcheck && pnpm --filter @elloria/api run check && pnpm --filter @elloria/web run lint && pnpm --filter @elloria/web run typecheck && pnpm --filter @elloria/web run build
scripts.db:setup: pnpm run db:up && pnpm run db:migrate
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @elloria/api run lint && pnpm run spellcheck && pnpm --filter @elloria/api run lint:knip && pnpm --filter @elloria/web run lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @elloria/api run typecheck && pnpm --filter @elloria/web run typecheck

description: Сайт жилого посёлка ELLORIA: каталог домов, медиагалерея и заявки
